name: outsource
description: Outsource implementation, investigation and vision-verdict work to third-party model CLIs (GLM-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash on the z.ai coding plan, grok-4.6, gemini-3.8-flash-high via the agy CLI, and any OpenRouter id via opencode), plus a codex-ci sidecar that redirects the Codex CLI at Cheaper Inference, as headless sub-agents, with spec linting, plan-quota gates and model-identity assertions, while the lead Claude session stays orchestration-only.
